_: Read by scripts/gates/dependency_boundary.py. This file is the one source
for the boundary exceptions; docs link here rather than restating them.
It replaces the hand-maintained inventory in docs/migration-touchpoints.md.
A list nothing checks is a list that is already wrong.

reason: The native file/folder picker used to open a vault. It is a shell
capability, not a vault operation: it returns a path and touches no
engine state, so routing it through cubical-ipc would add a command
whose whole body is 'ask the OS for a path'.
Declared rather than silently tolerated. If a second native shell
capability wants the same treatment, that is the signal to build a
proper shell-capability seam instead of extending this list.
